name: Job Tracker — save this posting
description: Save a job posting to your tracker from the page you're already looking at.
//: No host_permissions for job sites: the extension only reads a tab after you click it (activeTab). The optional entry is granted for one origin — the tracker API you configure — when you press Connect, because an unpacked install's chrome-extension:// id changes per machine and so cannot be listed in the API's CORS_ORIGINS.

save-posting.description: Save the current posting to the tracker
